themes: Negative: KYC Verification Failures - Users consistently report being stuck on the video KYC step, experiencing crashes or infinite loading screens, preventing them from opening accounts.
Negative: Delayed Customer Support - High volume of complaints regarding automated chatbot loops and unhelpful responses when trying to resolve money withdrawal issues.
Positive: Seamless UI/UX for Stocks - Users praise the clean, minimalist interface for tracking mutual funds and buying stocks, noting it is much faster than competitors.
quotes: Been trying to complete video KYC for 3 days. The app just crashes every time the camera opens. Very frustrating.
Support is useless. Just a bot sending the same article link. I need to know why my withdrawal is pending for 48 hours!
Best app for beginners. Super clean design, buying mutual funds takes literally 10 seconds. Love the portfolio tracking.
actions: Investigate Video KYC crash logs on Android devices; optimize camera memory usage and add fallback offline verification.
Implement an SLA for human-agent handover in support chat when users use keywords like 'stuck', 'withdrawal', or 'failed'.
Capitalize on UI praise by highlighting the speed of mutual fund investments in the upcoming marketing campaign.
